# Broski Talk

> Broski Talk is the AI podcast from Mark Santos and Simon Dziak about AI, tech and business: the AI tools, companies and business moves the two hosts actually use and follow, what's working, what isn't, and what's next. New episodes come out on YouTube every week.

Key facts: hosted by Mark Santos (runs Mark Studios, a video production studio) and Simon Dziak (App369). Episodes are 15 to 20 minutes long, each with chapters and a list of every link mentioned on the show. Short clips run on YouTube Shorts, Instagram and TikTok. The show first ran from 2020 to 2021 (19 episodes, live every Wednesday at 6 PM EST, about YouTube, money and mindset) and came back as an AI podcast in November 2026.

## Pages
- [Home](https://broskitalk.com/): the latest episode with its chapters, more episodes, shorts, the hosts and the email signup.
- [All episodes](https://broskitalk.com/episodes/): every episode, newest first, with dates and lengths. Each episode page (/episodes/<number>/) has the video, chapters and the episode's links.
- [Shorts](https://broskitalk.com/shorts/): every short, each linked to its full episode.
- [Newsletter](https://broskitalk.com/newsletter/): sign up for one email per new episode.
- [12 agent skills (free PDF)](https://broskitalk.com/free/12-skills/): the 12 agent skills from Episode 1's Builder's corner.
